-- REQ: LANG-591 LANG-592 LANG-593 LANG-594
with Ada.Text_IO; use Ada.Text_IO;

procedure Greeter is
   type Index is range 1 .. 10;
   Name  : constant String := "world";
   Count : Natural := 16#1F# + 1_000;
   Ratio : Float := 3.14;
   C     : Character := 'x';
   Done  : Boolean := False;

   function Square (X : Integer) return Integer is
   begin
      return X * X;
   end Square;
begin
   for I in Index'First .. Index'Last loop
      if I > 1 and then not Done then
         Put_Line ("Hello, " & Name & "! ""quoted""" & Integer'Image (Square (Integer (I))));
      end if;
   end loop;
   Done := True;
END Greeter;
